description: Check whether files the AI touched (or staged git files) are inside the active feature's TARGET FILES. Returns in-scope vs out-of-scope. In MCP there is no editor to block edits, so scope is enforced at commit time by the git pre-commit hook — this tool is the in-conversation check.

feature.description: Feature slug; omit for the active feature.

files.description: Files to check. Omit to read staged git files (git diff --cached --name-only).

name: cpfs_check_scope
